name: town
sentence: Build a walled town of about sixty houses with a market square and a keep.

preregistered.written_before:
the place spec was asked for, the site was searched for, a plateau was cut, the planner
was called or a block was placed. The structures band is `within the band the spec
produced (about sixty: 48-72)`, and 48 is the bar the driver reads because it takes one
comparator; 72 is the upper end and the place read (A6) holds the round to both.
preregistered.order:
place_spec -> site_search -> plateau -> site -> plan -> circulation -> cache -> parts ->
finish -> lint -> cards -> place_check -> judge -> readout. The sentence becomes a spec,
the spec chooses its ground, the ground is levelled where the search says it has to be,
and only then is there a site to brief a planner on.
preregistered.input: one sentence, and nothing else. No coordinates, no size, no voice: the kind, the band, the footprint, the site and the palette are all chosen inside the run and the record shows why. `site`, `voice` and `flags.types` are absent from this file on purpose and their absence is the claim.

place_read.note:
A6: the built place against the sentence's own spec, with no model call in it. Every
defining part present and standing; a wall the spec calls a wall is one closed loop of
the wall type with the gates on it, and a natural barrier does not count unless the
sentence said 'on a cliff'; the structure count inside the band; the voice's palette
against the ground's value. Holds or does not. scripts/test_place.py).

walk_from_outdoors_pct.note:
interior floor walkable from outdoors over the whole place, walk-only, under walk model
6. this asks it of a town four times the size.

e002_from_the_lane.note: doors reachable on foot from the lane. 0 in rounds 10 and 11.

own_lint_errors.note:
the build family over every part's own ground. A7 fixes that attribution and it is
registered here, before the number it moves is read.

instantiation.note:
per cent of the plan's leaves that stand. 100 of 14 leaves. 'Stand' is the type's own
answer, not the program's: a build() that refuses runs to the end and prepares the
ground, and an empty pad is an empty pad.

hand_programs.note:
programs in this build that are not an instance of a committed type. Every part is
composed by place.instantiate_part from a file under types/.

structures.note:
plot leaves in the plan, against the band the spec produced from the sentence: about
sixty is 48-72. The driver reads one comparator so the lower end is the bar; the upper
end is the place read's, which fails the round if the count is outside the band on
either side.

tokens_whole_round.note:
the place spec call, the place-level planner, one planner call per district, the keep
type author and the judge -- as the isolated subagents reported them.

site_chosen.note:
A3: the ground was chosen by the system and the record of why is on disk. 0 if a human
wrote a coordinate. This is the round's own claim as a number, because a claim nobody
measures is a comment.

reported_no_bar.place_spec: what the one schema call made of the sentence: kind, band, defining parts, and every number the library derived from them (out/town/place.json)
reported_no_bar.site_search: every radius scanned, how many candidates met the needs at each, and the top three with their measures (out/town/site_search.json)
reported_no_bar.plateau: whether the search marked the innermost defining part for terraforming, and what the cut took out (out/town/plateau.json)
reported_no_bar.voice: which voice was chosen against the ground, and by what rule
reported_no_bar.plan_levels: the place level and one level per district: what each was asked, what it answered, and whether it had to be handed back (out/town/plan_validation.json)
reported_no_bar.whole_place_lint_seconds: the one whole-place lint at the end.
reported_no_bar.structures_upper: the band's upper end of 72, reported beside the bar of 48
reported_no_bar.type_tokens: true tokens for the keep type author, against the round total
reported_no_bar.ground: which of deck, platform, plinth and footing each part was sited as
reported_no_bar.walk: a person, three questions -- can you get everywhere on foot? is this a walled town with a market and a keep? does it read as made?

rules_held: no coordinates, sizes or voices in this config; the system chooses and the record shows why
no builder call in the build; every part is an instance of a committed type
no new lint check in the frozen suite
no bar is moved; a miss is reported as a miss
